# The Konva shell's known differences from Konva 10.9.1 in Chromium 147, one
# per line, under the gap (docs/framework-gaps.md) that owns each.

# one that no longer occurs.

## 16 A mousedown on a non-focusable element leaves focus where it was; Chromium clears it (framework: divui/src/document.rs:2377-2385)
fill-and-visibility#5 focus: Div "toggle-visible", Chromium null
add-shapes#3 focus: Div "add-circle", Chromium null
restack-and-delete#6 focus: Div "delete", Chromium null
restack-and-delete#7 focus: Div "delete", Chromium null
restack-and-delete#8 focus: Div "delete", Chromium null
